name: RAFAEL PERINI VALLE
subtitle: PLANNING ENGINEER | PROJECT CONTROLS | OFFSHORE & OIL & GAS
tagline: MS Project · Schedule Control · Critical Path · Progress · Forecast · S-Curves · KPIs · Risk & Deviation Follow-up

sections.title: Professional Summary
bullets: Civil Engineer with active CREA registration and an MBA in Project Management from USP/ESALQ (400h, PMI/PMBOK-based), with 3+ years supporting planning, monitoring and control of marine projects at Van Oord, plus previous offshore Oil & Gas experience.

Hands-on experience with project schedules, critical path, milestones, physical and physical-financial progress, plan-versus-actual analysis, 15-day look-ahead, forecast, S-curves, costs, measurements, claims, KPIs and management reporting.
Advanced Microsoft Project and Excel, with Power BI for dashboards and performance analysis; Primavera P6 currently under development.

Strong multidisciplinary interface across project management, engineering/survey, vessel teams, QHSE, clients, suppliers and service providers, with focus on schedule deviations, corrective actions, risk follow-up and execution alignment.

lead.title: Professional Development & Independent Projects | Nov 2024–Present
lead.body: Professional development focused on Occupational Safety Engineering, data analysis, dashboards, automation and process structuring. Immediately available for a full-time return to Planning / Project Controls.

bullets: Developed and maintained project schedules using PCP and Microsoft Project, controlling sequencing, key durations, critical path, milestones and short-term execution priorities across multiple marine projects.

Monitored planned versus actual performance through production, vessel availability, downtime, fuel consumption and physical progress, identifying deviations and supporting corrective actions and recovery planning.
Updated short-term forecasts and approximately 15-day look-aheads, consolidating operational constraints, priorities, resources and impacts on project execution.
Prepared and followed daily, weekly and monthly progress reports, S-curves, KPIs and performance metrics for clients, project management and international leadership.
Supported cost, measurement, change and claims follow-up, correlating execution progress, operational constraints and schedule/cost impacts.

Facilitated planning and progress alignment with clients, vessel teams, engineering/survey, QHSE, suppliers and service providers, ensuring action follow-up and resolution of schedule-impacting issues.

entries.role: Operations Analyst | Offshore Planning & Project Support
bullets: Planned and monitored offshore maintenance and cleaning campaigns supporting FPSOs and OSVs, coordinating teams, materials, suppliers, documentation, logistics and operational readiness.
Tracked execution through DPR/RDO, indicators, progress and pending actions, addressing personnel, material, access and logistics constraints that could affect delivery.
Supported deliverables, measurement and cost control, contractor interfaces and Petrobras processes through Drake and SAP RT / PHTD.
Supported offshore mobilisation, transport requests, documentation, Petrobras DRAKE credentialing and operational readiness.
Supported multinational offshore teams through technical-English training, SOP translation and operational/emergency communication in a high-risk drilling environment.
